root_cause.text: The __ip6_tnl_rcv() function used pskb_inet_may_pull() which does not handle VLAN tags, so when a VLAN-encapsulated packet arrives, the inner IP header may not be pulled into the linear skb area, causing uninitialized memory access when reading ECN fields.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces pskb_inet_may_pull() with skb_vlan_inet_prepare() because the blamed commit "did not take care of VLAN encapsulations" (commit message). The syzbot stack trace shows an uninit-value BUG in __INET_ECN_decapsulate, triggered via ip6ip6_dscp_ecn_decapsulate, indicating that the inner header was not properly pulled, leaving uninitialized data in the skb.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace the simple linearization check with a VLAN-aware preparation function to fix handling of VLAN-tagged packets in IPv6 tunnel receive path.
intent_record.what: Replaced call to pskb_inet_may_pull() with call to skb_vlan_inet_prepare(skb, true), and removed the negation operator from the condition.
intent_record.how: Previously, the condition checked if the skb could not guarantee pulling the IP header; now it calls a function that prepares the skb for VLAN and IP processing, and drops the packet if that function returns an error.

commit 8d975c15c0cd744000ca386247432d57b21f9df0
Author: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date:   Thu Jan 25 17:05:57 2024 +0000

    ip6_tunnel: make sure to pull inner header in __ip6_tnl_rcv()
    
    syzbot found __ip6_tnl_rcv() could access unitiliazed data [1].
    
    Call pskb_inet_may_pull() to fix this, and initialize ipv6h
    variable after this call as it can change skb->head.
    
    [1]
     BUG: KMSAN: uninit-value in __INET_ECN_decapsulate include/net/inet_ecn.h:253 [inline]
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit adds a call to pskb_inet_may_pull() after skb_reset_network_header() (lines 839-842 in the new code) and moves the ipv6h pointer initialization after that call. This ensures that when a VLAN-encapsulated packet arrives, the inner IP header is pulled into the linear skb area, preventing uninitialized memory access when reading ECN fields. Therefore, the vulnerable construct (missing pull) is absent and the fix is present.
